newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybeans mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybeans mostly lower.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis offers dropped one cent a bushel in most positions despite transportation problems on the upper Mississippi River, dealers said.
"I guess that is not going to be part of the picture," one exporter said, referring to high water levels on the upper Mississippi below Minneapolis.

High water fed by melting snow forced more lock closures on the upper Mississippi River, hampering river navigation, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers said. The U.S. Coast Guard closed navigation on Thursday on the upper Mississippi River from Minneapolis, Minn., to Guttenberg, Iowa.
